templates.title: Immutable Goal MVP Loop
templates.summary: Bound a task to an immutable goal, decompose into focused MVPs, implement one MVP at a time, review against the goal, escalate through brave-search and ask when blocked or thrashing, then either continue or stop with receipts.
use_when: A project agent is thrashing or retrying without narrowing the work.
The human has declared an immutable goal and wants bounded progress.
Work should be decomposed into small MVPs with reviewer gates.
Blocked or confused states must trigger brave-search and ask escalation before continuing.

customization_slots.name: goal_hash
customization_slots.description: Hash of the immutable goal text or receipt.

customization_slots.name: immutable_goal
customization_slots.description: Plain-English goal that only the human may change.
